versions.introduction: This API allows public application developers to uninstall a customer’s account from their app. It is useful for cleanup when a customer stops using it and ensure there are no further incurred processing costs. Successful requests will receive a 204 response which also sends a notification email to account's Admins.
versions.useCase: Ideal when a customer has off-boarded from your platform but the integration remains installed in their HubSpot account. This API lets developers clean up stale installs, reduce unnecessary API traffic, and maintain accurate app state across systems.
